description:
Delete up to 1000 objects with one call. Keys that do not exist count as deleted.
    Objects that could not be deleted are listed in `errors`; retrying them is safe.
    Do not assume a deleted object can be restored: depending on the bucket's settings,
    deletion may be permanent.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

object_keys.description: Complete keys of the objects to delete, 1 to 1000.

name: delete_objects

outputSchema.description: Result of deleting multiple objects. Objects that did not exist count as deleted.

items.description: An object that was deleted, or did not exist.

delete_marker_version_id.description: Version ID of the delete marker the delete created, if any.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

errors.description: Objects that could not be deleted; retrying them is safe.

items.description: An object that could not be deleted.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

title: Delete Objects
